## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused on a single idea
- [ ] I ran the checks locally (`npm test`) and they pass
- [ ] I added or updated tests for any new behaviour
- [ ] Accessibility still holds (WCAG 2.2 AA) - no new axe/pa11y violations
- [ ] Content changes match the house style and do not change my meaning
- [ ] Any third-party code, images, or fonts are compatibly licensed and credited
